name: URL Parser
description: Split a URL into its parts, decode and edit query parameters, and remove tracking parameters
help: Paste or type a URL; it is split into scheme, user, host, port, path, query and fragment with every percent-encoded part decoded. Without a scheme, https:// is assumed (localhost:8080 also works).
Internationalised domain names are shown in both punycode and Unicode, and the default port of the scheme is shown when none is given.
Query parameters can be edited, added, removed and sorted; the rebuilt URL appears at the bottom. Choose whether spaces become %20 or + (form style), then copy it or apply it to the input.
Remove tracking clears utm_* and common click and share parameters (fbclid, gclid, spm, vd_source and more) and keeps everything else.
A link on the clipboard can open this tool from the command palette.
